description.en: Reads a global bit flag, one of the 2560 story and progress flags (numbers 0 to 2559). The flags live in the game's flag data (part of the save data).

true if the flag is set, false otherwise (also false if the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A branch on story progress (real usage, from ev42010450.nut)
